app.name: Athanor
landing.hero.subhead: Not a social network: the community where reputation is earned through action, not followers.
landing.download.title: Take Athanor with you.
landing.manifesto.title: They teach you not to shine. You — burn instead.
landing.manifesto.body: Social media taught us to scroll through time; Athanor teaches us to seize it. No followers to hoard, no vanity metrics: only real people, moments that matter, projects that come to life. And one question at the heart of every profile: "what is your dream?".
landing.pillars.title: Six pillars. At the centre, always, the person and their dream.

landing.aura.quote: On Athanor you do not count followers. You light your Aura.
landing.aura.body: Aura is evolutionary reputation: a living value that grows only through real, verifiable actions. No one can buy or fake it; it fades with inactivity and is never inherited — it is kept burning.
landing.sogno.body: Every profile shows what no other platform asks for: the owner's dream. Not a job title, but a direction. Beside it sits a button — "Make this dream happen" — and the dream stops being private: it becomes a collective project.
landing.daivita.quote: Here, dreams aren't told. They come true.
landing.daivita.body: Once a year, the whole community lights a single fire: one dream chosen by everyone and made real by everyone. You contribute from €1, and 90% goes to the dream. Thousands of people, one dream made real — and next time it could be you.
landing.close.quote: Somewhere on Athanor, there is a person who is the right moment for your dream.

landing.meta.description: Athanor is the community where reputation is earned through action, not followers. Real people, moments that matter, projects that come to life. Coming soon to iOS and Android.
landing.nome.quote: Alone, time is a circle. Together, it is the flame that rises between two circles.
landing.nome.body: Athanor is the alchemist's furnace: the vessel that keeps the fire, where base matter transmutes into gold. The infinite scroll is a circle spinning alone — motion without progress. But when two circles meet, a mandorla forms, a crucible: it is Kairos, the instant two people truly meet. And from that meeting, gold is born.
landing.problem.title: The more connected we are, the lonelier we feel.
landing.problem.follower: Followers ≠ trust — a high number says nothing about a person's worth.
landing.problem.scroll: Infinite scroll — designed to retain you, not to grow you.
landing.problem.networking: Shallow networking — contacts that never become collaborations.
landing.problem.tools: Fragmented tools — one app to talk, another to work, another for events.
landing.problem.growth: No growth — no platform measures what truly counts: who you are becoming.
landing.problem.target: Too professional for Instagram, too human for LinkedIn. Athanor is the space that was missing.

landing.stars.collaboratore.desc: Builds together, with consistency and reliability.
landing.stars.ambasciatore.desc: Brings new people and guards Athanor's culture.
